messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Streaming p99 tail latency spike detected for /v1/stream and /v1/chat/stream across eu-west-1 proxies. Current p99 = 2.7s (SLO 1.2s). Error-rate stable. Paging oncall: @ryan (pager duty). :rotating_light:
ryan (oncall): Acked. grabbing context. Which customers affected? any 5xx or just slow chunks?
maya (sre): No 5xx showing, just delayed chunk arrival and increased SSE socket waits. Client backpressure spiking on proxy. See quick grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/d/streaming?panelId=5 (p95/p99 overlays).
alex (platform): Seeing queue growth in proxy pod group proxy-eu-1: in-flight connections up ~40%. Upstream to runtime shows sustained write latency. Likely congestion in proxy -> worker TCP windows.
lina (support): Support queue flagged 3 accounts reporting streaming stalls (chat web UI shows 'waiting for response...'). Customers: AcmeHealth (low volume), FlowApps (api), DemoCorp (web). All EU region.
ryan (oncall): Ok first mitigations: (1) increase proxy write timeout to 15s for SSE routes, (2) enable short-circuiting to fallback non-streaming route for affected customers, (3) scale proxy replicas + bump worker connection pool. I'll run the commands.
deploy-bot: @ryan started runbook: streaming-p95-spike-mitigation (runbook v2.1).
ryan (oncall): Running k8s patch: ``kubectl -n infra patch deploy proxy-eu-1 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"proxy","env":[{"name":"SSE_WRITE_TIMEOUT","value":"15s"}]}]}}}}'`` will push rolling restart.
maya (sre): While that rolls, let's confirm whether prefix cache is stalling. Querying runtime metrics: ``sum(rate(runtime.kv_cache.evictions[1m])) by (model)`` -> small. Not the cache. Also checking kernel-level netstat: many CLOSE_WAIT on proxy side.
alex (platform): Rolling proxies up by +2 replicas and patching envoy upstream idle_timeout. Also routing rule adjusted to prefer dedicated capacity if available for high-throughput customers.
jordan (pm): Heads-up: FlowApps on a billing cycle release in 2 hours; they'll notice. Lina can you pre-send a short note saying we're mitigating and may degrade streaming? Keep message minimal.
lina (support): Drafting: "We're aware of streaming latency in EU. Engineers have mitigations rolling (proxy scaling + timeouts). If you see stalls, switch to non-streaming endpoints momentarily. We'll update in ~15m." Will send after confirmation.
maya (sre): Patch applied to worker pool to increase socket send buffer and reduce write coalescing: ``sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_wmem='4096 87380 6291456'`` and tuned runtime backpressure thresholds. Watching metrics.
ryan (oncall): After scale + timeouts, p95 moved from 0.9s -> 0.8s, p99 from 2.7s -> 1.1s. Progress. Need to keep monitoring for tail re-emergence.
alex (platform): Observed a small spike of proxy file-descriptor exhaustion during the first 30s of the rollout — remediation: increase ulimit for envoy and restart affected pods. Patch in flight.
maya (sre): Confirming no elevated 5xx from runtime. Client-side traces show delayed chunk flushing at the proxy layer. Likely backlog in proxy write loop when many idle sockets exist.
ryan (oncall): Request to ops: Can we apply an emergency rate-limit at the edge per-IP for long-lived SSE connections? That should give breathing room.
alex (platform): Edge rule applied: limit concurrent SSE sessions per IP to 20 for eu-west-1. Also set keepalive probes to 30s.
deploy-bot: Completed rollout: proxies scaled to +2, config patches applied by @alex.
jordan (pm): Good mitigation. Lina: send customer note now.
lina (support): Sent to impacted customers. Sample note included link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2468504321.
ryan (oncall): Handing off to Maya for post-mortem and root cause. My shift ends in 20m. Summary for handoff: "Mitigations: increased SSE write timeout, scaled proxy replicas, tuned TCP buffers & runtime backpressure, applied edge concurrent-session limits. Observable: p99 reduced to ~1.1s; customer visible stalls reduced. Next: deep-dive into proxy write loop/backpressure and long-lived connection handling; verify kernel-level socket states during peak; consider persistent config to enforce per-route streaming connection limits."
maya (sre): Ack. I'll create follow-up ticket and include perf traces, flame graphs, and a reproducible load script. Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform.
ryan (oncall): One more note — check for any unusual client behaviour causing head-of-line blocking (like large initial payloads). Lina, ask customers if they saw large payloads or retries.
lina (support): Will collect and attach to the ticket.
jordan (pm): Postmortem owners: eng-runtime (maya), eng-platform (alex). Timeline: initial alert -> mitigations applied -> p99 back within SLO = ~18m. Will schedule blameless postmortem and RCA.
maya (sre): Saved traces and uploaded to /shared/incidents/2468504321/traces.log. Adding logs snippet: ```[2024-07-15T10:14:05Z] proxy-eu-1 envoy: upstream write timeout after 500ms backlog=342 conn=1123```
ryan (oncall): Thanks team. tagging: @eng-runtime @eng-platform for visibility. Leaving handoff notes in PagerDuty. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
maya (sre): Closing live handoff thread. Will post next update in the incident postmortem doc with timeline and root cause hypothesis.
